title: Provision the missing Wildheart free-domain alias and verify canonical redirects

source.ref: Daniel November 4 audit and approved launch scope

detail: The audit found wildheart.frequencylocal.com points to Vercel but fails TLS, and its alias is absent from the verified project-domain list. Attach and verify only the intended free alias through the established provider workflow. Verify the certificate, root and nested-page permanent redirects, and canonical destination. Preserve the working custom site and the existing admin, API, booking-confirmation, Spotlight and chapter exceptions.

verify.evidence: 86 read-only public checks covered six custom domains. Wildheart free-alias TLS failed on five attempts; its exact provider lookup returned 404 and the 32-domain inventory omitted it. No provider settings changed. Acceptance requires trusted TLS, matching-page redirects and an unchanged working custom site.
